subject: Post-demo econ recap: token bands, target $/1M and founder sponsorship request
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Jurado <marta@lumena.ai>, Luca Romano <luca.romano@lumena.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo econ recap: token bands, target $/1M and next steps

Hi Marta and Luca —

Thanks again for the time today — nice demo from your side and great questions on latency and cost profiling. Quick recap of the things we committed to after our call: 

- Narrow down expected monthly token volume ranges (low / expected / high). You said 300M / 1.2B / 2.5B tokens as a working set.
- Target unit economics: you mentioned wanting to land around $2.5k–$3.5k per 1M tokens in production (including caching/batching gains).
- Founder-sponsorship ask: Marta asked whether Lumena (seed-stage, raised pre-seed) could get a startup sponsorship + an introductory rebate tied to a 6–12 month committed band.

Action items: 
1) Could you confirm the monthly ranges in an email reply (we'll use them to size the quote)?
2) I’ll loop Ben and Karthik to propose two paths: a short-term starter rebate (90 days) vs. a modest 6–12 month committed band with graduated discounts.
3) We’ll attach a concise written quote + the founder program terms for legal to review.

I’ll aim to send the proposal by EOD tomorrow — anything you want added to the proposal (e.g., seats, support hours, private deployment) let me know.

Best,
Vanessa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Marta Jurado <marta@lumena.ai>

Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 16:40:12 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-demo econ recap: token bands, target $/1M and next steps

Thanks Vanessa —

Confirming our expected ranges: low 280M, expected 1.1B, high 2.4B tokens / month. The $/1M target is more like $3k in year 1 if we can get sensible caching assumptions running (we expect a lot of prefix reuse).

On the founder-sponsorship: we are pre-seed and have a small cap table, so any program that accelerates runway is helpful. Ideally something that covers an initial 3–6 month runway while we validate LLM UX in a closed beta. We are open to a short commitment if there’s an introductory rebate attached.

Also want to flag procurement: our legal prefers a simple MSA; we’ll share the PO and billing cadence after we pick a model/price.

— Marta
Co-founder & CTO, Lumena AI

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marta Jurado <marta@lumena.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo econ recap: token bands, target $/1M and next steps

Vanessa / Karthik —

Thanks for the ranges, Marta — that helps. Karthik and I discussed two clean paths we can offer Lumena:

Path A — Starter sponsorship (no long-term commitment):
- 90-day founder sponsorship: 50% off list rate for first 90 days, up to 500M tokens total across the 90d window.
- No commitment after sponsorship; standard pay-as-you-go rates apply.
- Good for rapid validation with minimal procurement friction.

Path B — Committed starter (6 months):
- 6-month committed band at 600M tokens/month with a graduated discount: month 1–2 = 40% off list, month 3–4 = 30% off, month 5–6 = 20% off.
- If monthly usage exceeds band, overage billed at 60% of list (effectively a smaller incremental discount).
- Requires a simple purchase order and a one-page addendum to the MSA.

Notes on unit econ (assumptions):
- We bake in an additional 15–25% effective saving for KV caching and batching at your expected latency profile. That should move your $/1M from raw list toward your $3k target under Path B if usage concentrates on reuseable prefixes.
- We recommend enabling prefix caching and the per-route cost tracing in the console during the beta so we can measure realized token savings and adjust the bands.

I’m attaching a draft quote and the founder program terms. Vanessa — if you want, I can create the quote with Lumena-specific numbers (target $/1M, projected monthly bill) and send it to Marta tomorrow morning.

-Ben
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

Marta / Luca —

Attaching the lean proposal and the founder program terms for your review. Quick highlights tailored to your stated ranges: 

- Option 1 (Founder Sponsorship): 90 days, 50% off up to 500M tokens. Ideal if you want to validate without procurement.
- Option 2 (6-month committed starter): 600M/mo band with graduated discounts (40/30/20). Hit your targets around ~$2.9k–$3.4k per 1M tokens depending on prefix reuse rate.

What I’m asking for as the next step:
1) Pick the path that fits runway and procurement comfort (reply with Option 1 or Option 2).
2) If Option 2, confirm the exact monthly band (we defaulted to 600M but can adjust).
3) If you want the PO and MSA addendum drafted, we can expedite and expect 48–72 hour turnaround from your procurement team once the band is confirmed.

We included a short FAQ in the Founder-Program-Terms PDF about how overages and roll-forward credits work. If you want to see a worked example of your monthly bill given 1.1B actual throughput and a 30% effective caching rate, tell us and we’ll run the numbers alongside the quote.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 15-min call Monday if that helps to align procurement.

Best,
Vanessa
